title: Before GTA6 Arrives, Phantom Blade Zero Is a Must-Play PS5 Title
description: As the gaming world anticipates GTA6, media previews hail Phantom Blade Zero as an essential PS5 action experience following a six-hour hands-on session with S-GAME's impressive title.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Introduction: The Action Masterpiece Before the GTA6 Era

When looking at the modern gaming landscape, all bets are off once GTA 6 finally arrives and reshapes the industry. However, in the precious weeks leading up to that monumental release, players are being urged to let another title consume their free time: *Phantom Blade Zero*.

According to recent reports from gaming media outlet Push Square, a comprehensive six-hour deep dive into the action title during a trip to Beijing has revealed one of the most confident and impressive Western debuts from a developer in years. Rather than a studio struggling to find its footing in the competitive action genre, S-GAME appears fully primed to lead it.

## Six Hours of Pure Action Excellence

Spending six hours hands-on with a game provides a rare opportunity to look past the marketing and promotional hype. The extended session highlighted outstanding combat mechanics and intricate boss encounters that are set to make the S-GAME project one of the standout gaming experiences of the year.

The fluid motion, responsive controls, and high-stakes encounters showcase a level of polish rarely seen in early studio efforts of this scale. While the shadow of Rockstar's upcoming masterpiece looms large over the entire industry, titles like *Phantom Blade Zero* are proving that there is plenty of room for elite-tier action games to capture our attention right now.

## Editor's Take

While the anticipation for GTA6 is completely unmatched, *Phantom Blade Zero* delivers the exact kind of high-octane action remedy players need in the interim. Backed by stellar combat and unforgettable boss fights, it easily stands on its own as a definitive PS5 highlight.
